digest.en: Trump announces new tariffs on generic drugs to take effect in 2028 in the Middle East and Africa region, amidst ongoing trade tensions between the US and Canada. Meanwhile, Canada cancels its joint bridge-opening celebration with the US, a symbolic gesture of strained relations. The US claims of Cuba's 'unique threat' contrast with the reality of hunger and blackouts in the country.

articles.title: One Business Lost, A Second In Flames. Despite Russia's War, A Ukrainian Entrepreneur Won't Quit.
